tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Cisco UCS C240 M6 Rack Server is a powerful 2U enterprise server designed for demanding data center, virtualization, cloud computing, database, storage, and business applications. Built on the Cisco UCS platform, the C240 M6 delivers a flexible and scalable server architecture with support for high-performance Intel Xeon Scalable processors, DDR4 memory, enterprise storage, PCIe expansion, and advanced network connectivity.


The Cisco UCS C240 M6 is suitable for organizations looking for reliable computing performance, high memory capacity, flexible storage configurations, and efficient data center infrastructure. Its 2U rack-mount design makes it an excellent choice for enterprise server rooms and modern data centers where performance and scalability are important.


Key Features


  • Cisco UCS C240 M6 2U Rack Server
  • Supports dual Intel Xeon Scalable processors
  • High-capacity DDR4 ECC memory support
  • Multiple DIMM slots for memory expansion
  • Flexible SAS, SATA, and NVMe storage options depending on configuration
  • Enterprise RAID controller support
  • PCIe expansion slots for networking, storage, and accelerator cards
  • Advanced Cisco Integrated Management Controller
  • Designed for virtualization and cloud infrastructure
  • Suitable for databases, enterprise applications, and data analytics
  • 2U rack-mount form factor for efficient data center deployment
  • Scalable platform for growing business requirements
